ns2:course.label: Audiology Clinical Practicum Full-Time Externship
ns2:course.description: Advanced supervised assessment and management of patients in a full-time audiology externship. Includes audiological evaluation techniques; treatment counseling; amplification selection, evaluation, and dispensing; and aural rehabilitation. 1 to 5 graduate hours. No professional credit. This course may be repeated up to three times. Prerequisite: SHS 557. Graduate standing in Speech and Hearing Science, in 4th year of the AuD curriculum.
